# Gamma Functions

![Gamma Functions function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/gamma/00_Gamma%20repertoire.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Seven palette entries and nine scalar signatures: Gamma and Beta offer explicit Complete (default) or Regularized Incomplete instances. Scalar baseline only. Real numeric inputs promote visibly to f64; n must be exact i32. Every output is f64. No arrays, clusters, complex arguments, angle conversion or broadcasting. Classic LabVIEW scalar connectors and documented conventions; not verified NXG signatures or measured NI runtime parity. FROG owns the versioned numerical profile, Stirling first term and explicit shape/limit mapping. The missing 00 directory resource uses the existing generic folder.

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Gamma](../../math/gamma/complete.md) | Gamma(x), the real extension of factorial. x is required; nonpositive integers are poles; negative nonintegers retain their sign. Complete is the default instance. Formula: Gamma(x). Example: Gamma(5)=24. |
| [Stirling](../../math/gamma/stirling_leading.md) | First Stirling term for Gamma at r=abs(x)&gt;0: sqrt(2*pi)*r^(r-1/2)*exp(-r), evaluated in log space. FROG stirling_leading_v1 is an approximation whose NI truncation was not verified. Formula: exp((r-0.5)*ln(r)-r+0.5*ln(2*pi)), r=abs(x). Example: Stirling(1)=0.9221370088957891. |
| [Beta](../../math/beta/complete.md) | Complete Beta B(x,y), symmetric in strictly positive real shapes x and y. Both inputs are required. Complete is the default instance. Formula: B(x,y). Example: Beta(2,3)=1/12. |
| [Ln(n!)](../../math/gamma/log_factorial.md) | Natural logarithm of factorial for required exact i32 n&gt;=0. Evaluate logGamma(double(n)+1), without computing factorial first or overflowing i32 addition. Fractional values are rejected; no truncation. Formula: ln(Gamma(double(n)+1)). Example: Ln(5!)=4.787491742782046. |
| [Ln Gamma](../../math/gamma/log_complete.md) | Natural logGamma(abs(x)) for required finite x!=0, directly evaluated. This NI documented abs adapter differs from log(abs(Gamma(x))) for negative x. Formula: ln(Gamma(abs(x))). Example: LnGamma(-0.5)=0.5723649429247001. |
| [GammaC](../../math/gamma/regularized_upper.md) | Regularized upper Gamma Q(shape=abs(x),limit=a). Both real f64 inputs are required; abs(x)&gt;0 and a&gt;=0, including +Infinity. Q is evaluated directly to preserve small tails, rather than 1-P. The x/shape and a/limit mapping is an explicit FROG adaptation; NI graphic indexing was not verified. Formula: Q(abs(x),a). Example: GammaC(2,3)=0.19914827347145578. |
| [Digamma](../../math/gamma/digamma.md) | Psi, the logarithmic derivative of Gamma, evaluated at abs(x)&gt;0 under the NI documented negative-input adapter. Required finite real x, no finite differences. Formula: psi(abs(x)). Example: psi(1)=-0.5772156649015329. |
| [Gamma — Regularized Incomplete](../../math/gamma/regularized_lower.md) | Explicit Regularized Incomplete instance: P(shape=x,limit=a), x&gt;0 and a&gt;=0. x is required; optional a defaults to +Infinity and returns 1, never Gamma(x). The x/shape and a/limit mapping is an explicit FROG adaptation; NI graphic indexing was not verified. Formula: P(x,a). Example: P(2,3)=0.8008517265285442. |
| [Beta — Regularized Incomplete](../../math/beta/regularized_lower.md) | Explicit Regularized Incomplete instance: I_a(x,y), strictly positive real shapes x,y and 0&lt;=a&lt;=1. x,y are required; optional a defaults to 1 and returns 1, never Beta(x,y). Formula: I_a(x,y). Example: I_0.5(2,3)=0.6875. |
